Structured Relation Plugin v0.9 validation
==========================================
Runtime: ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 (internal test build, 3 Aug 2026)
NoSQLServer: v0.73
HardWorld bridge: virtual_ryta_hardworld v0.17
Legal Effect bridge: v0.5

v0.9 delta
----------
- Non-EDIFACT /* ... */ source annotations appearing between segments are preserved as
  EdiFactSourceAnnotation objects with exact source spans and ignored by EDIFACT grammar.
- UNG/UNE functional groups are first-class EdiFactFunctionalGroup objects.
- Messages/segments retain functional-group identity; @groupReference is projectable.
- Envelope validation checks functional-group message count/reference and uses group count
  for UNZ control-count validation when functional groups are present.
- Fictional OurLadyAir PNRGOV fixture retained as an adversarial source example.

OurLadyAir fixture observed
---------------------------
segments:     187
UNH messages: 16
UNG groups:     7
annotations:   17
SSR segments:  28
TIF segments:  25
TKT segments:  25

The source deliberately fails envelope validation with 17 findings, including an outer UNH
without a matching UNT, per-message UNT segment-count mismatches, and UNZ count mismatch.
The parser does not repair or hide those defects.

NoSQL commercial-evidence smoke
-------------------------------
G07A MACLEOD/DECLAN  SSR NSST / SEAT NOT PURCHASED
G07B ROBERTSON/NOOR  SSR NSST / SEAT NOT PURCHASED
G07C OKAFOR/SUSAN    SSR NSST / SEAT NOT PURCHASED

Compound join over group_ref + message_ref returns exactly 3 G07 passengers.
Demo pricing rule supplied with fixture: EUR20 per unreserved seat => EUR60 total.
G02 and G06 return zero NSST rows because they already carry SSR+SEAT even though seats
are scattered; the parser/query layer does not infer a charge from descriptive comments.

v0.77 federation compatibility refresh (24 Aug 2026)
----------------------------------------------------
NoSQLServer v0.77 metadata construction reads the neutral external-column `textMode`
message. Structured Relation projection columns now expose `textMode = CLASSIC` while
retaining their native source/value/provenance objects unchanged. This is an adapter
surface compatibility addition only; SQL/text semantics remain owned by NoSQLServer.
